text:
kelly (People Ops): idea — run a "Tiny Triumphs" lapel pin drop across offices the week before Q2 all-hands. small physical recognition for quick wins. low cost, high feel-good. thoughts?

marta (People Ops Manager): love it. budget? vendor recs? we should tie to the micro-grant nominations. :sparkles:

sam (Designer): I mocked up 3 pin concepts, attaching filenames: tiny-triumphs-v1.png, v2.png, v3.png. v2 is my fav — enamel, two-color.

kelly (People Ops): perfect. target qty = 200 US, 100 EU, 50 APAC to start. estimated budget ~ $1200 including shipping? open to adjustments.

ahmed (Procurement): flag — for enamel pins vendors we use: pinworks.co and simplepins.io. lead times ~ 10-14 business days for 500 qty. pricing estimate from previous orders: $2.10 per pin + $120 tooling. will confirm final quote.

lisa (Office Ops): distribution note — desk drops easiest in US/EU offices; APAC we should do manager bundles for pickup. will need inventory spreadsheet with name/office/address.

marta (People Ops Manager): can we get personalization (initials engraving)? small extra but could make them feel special. what's the delta on cost?

ahmed (Procurement): engraving's +$0.40/pin and adds 3 days to lead time. need a CSV of names -> engraving text. if we do personalization, smaller batch recommended (to avoid per-pin surcharges).

sam (Designer): mock with engraving guidance: max 6 chars, uppercase. updated art file tiny-triumphs-v2-engrave.png.

kelly (People Ops): decision point: personalized for nominated folks only (approx 150), plain for general runway stock. approve?

marta (People Ops Manager): approve. allocate $900 from Q2 culture budget and $400 from spot-award discretionary. ops to collect names by 1969540000.

lisa (Office Ops): I'll create a simple Google form for recipients + pickup options. will post link here when ready.

ahmed (Procurement): putting request into our vendor tracker now. preliminary PO draft:
```
vendor: pinworks.co
item: enamel lapel pin - Tiny Triumphs
qty: 350 (150 personalized, 200 plain)
tooling: $120
unit_price: $2.10
engraving: $0.40 per personalized
shipping: TBD
lead_time: 14 business days
```

kelly (People Ops): thanks. timeline check — if PO sent this week, shipping arrives by 1969528000? is that realistic? we need pins in-hand 1 week before Q2 all-hands.

ahmed (Procurement): yes sending PO today should hit that window assuming no customs delays. will add air freight option for APAC if needed.

sam (Designer): can Ops also confirm packaging — tiny card with short note? I can layout a 2x3 card that fits standard envelope.

lisa (Office Ops): yes please. volunteer packers needed for US office day-of. I'll open a signup sheet. 10 volunteers should handle 200 desk drops in ~2 hours.

marta (People Ops Manager): kelly — can you draft the short note copy? 1-2 lines recommended.

kelly (People Ops): draft: "Tiny Triumphs: a small thank-you for the everyday wins you bring to Redwood. Keep doing what you do." short and warm. feedback?

sam (Designer): love it. matches the art. :heart:

ops-bot: reminder scheduled — send names CSV and finalize PO by 1969540000.

kelly (People Ops): final checklist here: 1) finalize art (sam) 2) send PO (ahmed) 3) collect names CSV (marta + form from lisa) 4) packaging + volunteer signups (lisa) 5) confirm shipping & drop schedule (ahmed). I'll update this thread when each item is done. thanks everyone :tada:
